text:
Situation: Azithromycin 500 mg tablets (NDC 71205067403, labeled by Proficient Rx LP) have been on FDA's shortage list for 56 months as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 7.6 days of supply (120 tablets); Corvale General holds 23.4 days (368 tablets). Both 250 mg strengths remain above 14 days at each site.

Why (FDA record): FDA lists the product as "To Be Discontinued" since 2022-02-22. Proficient Rx LP's registered plant (FEI 3011557028) received a VAI classification on inspection 1194148 ending 2022-12-08, 289 days after the shortage posting.

Our position: The 500 mg tablet supply is critically low at Corvale East. Alternate manufacturers Advanced Rx Pharmacy of Tennessee, LLC; Advanced Rx of Tennessee, LLC; Alembic Pharmaceuticals Inc.; and Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited are not on FDA's shortage list today, but their labels name no plant we could place for verification.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 101 tablets of 500 mg from Corvale General to Corvale East — approved by pharmacy director (transfer request).
2. Evaluate purchase from Advanced Rx Pharmacy of Tennessee, LLC — approved by buyer.
3. Evaluate purchase from Advanced Rx of Tennessee, LLC — approved by buyer.
4. Evaluate purchase from Alembic Pharmaceuticals Inc. — approved by buyer.
5. Evaluate purchase from Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited — approved by buyer.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or formulary substitutions at this time; those decisions rest with treating clinicians and the committee.
